mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and depress corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% for two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer and business confidence that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with both RSAFS and HOUST rising, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a rebound in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of post-recession periods with INDPRO rebounding, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls over three consecutive months signals robust job growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS rising for three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate and increase in industrial production indicates a strengthening economy with tight labor markets and robust manufacturing, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE declining and INDPRO rising, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During low-rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), a year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that may lead to premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 1.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
